mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates an exceptionally accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST < 900) and GDP growth (GDPC1 < 15900) signals contraction in the housing sector and overall economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST < 900 and GDPC1 < 15900.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 235), the Federal Reserve's rate hikes to combat inflation reduce corporate profitability and equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 235.

mechanism_narrative: An industrial production index above 100 (relative to 2017=100) indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment growth below 138,000 persons signals a slowing labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS < 138000.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in retail sales (RSAFS < 430000) and housing starts (HOUST < 900) signals weakening consumer and housing demand, triggering negative equity returns due to reduced economic activity over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS < 430000 and HOUST < 900.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 > 15900 and CPIAUCSL > 235), the Federal Reserve's anticipated rate hikes to prevent inflation overshoots reduce equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 > 15900 and CPIAUCSL > 235.
